The data lake

One database under the book. Yours.

Government records are the foundation. Listings, web data, property data and skip tracing layer on top. It all lands in one database you own.

Open government dataNYS assessment rolls, 4,727,130 parcels in 57 counties. County tax maps, deeds, filed maps. Town zoning. Suffolk sanitary code. The NYC lot file.
MLS · land classExpired, live and sold land for two years. Checked so nothing relisted or sold stays in the book.
Web dataListing sites, maps and classifieds, swept weekly for what just listed and what just died.
Property dataOwner of record, mailing address, mortgages, liens and portfolio linkage across every parcel.
Skip trace + verificationMobiles, landlines, email, line type and Do Not Call. Validated before the first text.
Event signalsExpired, aged expired, estate, pre-foreclosure, new deeds, builder moves. Each lot gets a reason to call now.
Your own databaseAI-ready Postgres on your DigitalOcean account. Fully managed. Nothing to learn. No training. Every update, trace, signal and reply lands in it. It compounds, and it stays yours.
